page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture using the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core processing capabilities, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and PassMark CPU scores falling into the top 25% tier. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI, which is reflected in its strong PassMark CPU encryption test results. Multi-threaded decompression tasks also perform in the top 25% tier, while single-core operations, memory bandwidth, and static web serving throughput register in the average range.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio represents a compute-heavy design, offering high processing density but limited memory capacity per core compared to general-purpose or memory-optimized instances. This makes the instance cost-efficient for CPU-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local disk storage. Appropriate workloads include multi-threaded data processing, cryptographic operations, database transactions, and small-scale LLM inference tasks.
